delivery_date.description: The requested delivery or shipment date, commonly labelled Delivery Date, Required Date, Ship Date, or Due Date. Normalize to DD/MM/YYYY format; if only month and year appear, record as 01/MM/YYYY.

delivery_address.title: Delivery Address
